com.unitech.lib.rgx

Class RG768Reader

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.unitech.lib.reader.BaseReader
      • com.unitech.lib.rgx.RG768Reader
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    com.unitech.lib.device.IDeviceEventListener, com.unitech.lib.device.IReader, com.unitech.lib.transport.event.IConnectStateEventListener

    public class RG768Reader
extends BaseReader
implements com.unitech.lib.device.IDeviceEventListener
    The RG768Reader class is a class that controls RG768, receives data from RM100, and delivers it to the application program.
